One event matching two NIP-45 filters should count once.

relayer 2.2.19 adds `FiltersCounter` so a storage backend can evaluate multiple `COUNT` filters as one OR union. Its new overlap test returns 4 where separate per-filter counts would sum to 6.

The fallback still sums filters when the backend does not implement the new interface. Exact results for overlapping filters therefore depend on storage support.
